title: Quaint Venezuelan Plantain Empanadas
description: Buttery and shattering, these empanadas are a delicious date night Venezuelan dish, featuring granulated sugar and a soffritto base, and are Jain friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the melted butter and soffritto base to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and continue mixing until the dough is smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a sliced plantain in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the plantain to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
